verdict.rationale: A self-serve eligibility checker is a fair capability to ask of an immigration law firm, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only consultation booking, practice-area descriptions, visa PDFs and a newsletter. Nothing documents a free structured O-1/EB-1 qualifier or assessment tool on the site.

support.subject: As a founder, I can run a free structured eligibility check — a self-serve O-1/EB-1 qualifier or assessment tool on the provider's site
